verdict.rationale: gstack has its own install mechanism: docs mention a setup step, global vs vendored/project-local installs, and skills living in the agent's skills directory, and a community member describes a git-clone-and-copy install model. Nothing in the evidence documents a single one-liner (package manager, CLI or marketplace command), and nothing confirms the skills are active in the next session. Missing for 10: a documented single install command, evidence of next-session activation, and independent hands-on install corroboration.
